question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become a supported public plugin-SDK contract, or should this coordination remain internal to bundled runtime paths?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but adding a reusable external progress-intent API is a durable compatibility and ownership choice that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Approve Public Contract
options.body: Keep the exports, document their semantics and stability, and require exact-head lifecycle proof before merge.

options.title: Keep It Internal
options.body: Replace the public exports with a narrow internal generic seam used by bundled Codex and Slack only.

options.title: Pause For Broader Design
options.body: Hold the change until maintainers define a cross-channel progress-presentation contract.

recommendation.title: Approve Public Contract
recommendation.body: Keep the exports, document their semantics and stability, and require exact-head lifecycle proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history spans both the Slack delivery paths and public reply-payload SDK contract decisions affected here.
